# Kolmac Integrated Behavioral Health

> > Kolmac provides evidence-based outpatient addiction and mental health treatment across the Mid-Atlantic region with intensive programs, medication-assisted therapy, and specialized care for substance use and behavioral health disorders.

Kolmac Integrated Behavioral Health operates multiple treatment centers across Maryland, Pennsylvania, Virginia, and Washington DC, offering comprehensive outpatient programs including intensive outpatient programs (IOP), partial hospitalization programs (PHP), and medication-assisted treatment for addiction recovery and mental health conditions.

## Key Topics

- Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP)
- Substance Use Disorder Treatment
- Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT/MOUD)
- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT)
- Opioid Addiction Treatment
- Alcohol Use Disorder
- Mental Health Services
- Evidence-Based Therapy
- Outpatient Rehab
- Addiction Recovery
- Trauma-Focused Treatment
- Depression & Anxiety Treatment
- Adolescent Mental Health
- SAMHSA-Certified Programs

## Treatment Programs & Services

- [What We Treat - Substance Abuse & Addiction Treatment](https://www.kolmac.com/what-we-treat): Overview of conditions treated: substance use, alcohol, opioid, and co-occurring disorders.
- [Drug Addiction / Substance Use Disorder Treatment Programs at Kolmac](https://www.kolmac.com/what-we-treat/drug-addiction): Substance use disorder treatment with outpatient and virtual detox/rehab options.
- [Opioid & Painkiller Addiction - Kolmac Integrated Behavioral Health Centers](https://www.kolmac.com/what-we-treat/opioid-painkiller-addiction): Opioid addiction treatment with MAT/MOUD and outpatient/virtual rehab services.
- [Alcohol & Drug Treatment | Outpatient Rehab in DC, VA, MD & PA](https://www.kolmac.com/what-we-treat/alcohol-use-disorder): Alcohol use disorder treatment with medication-assisted and intensive outpatient programs.
- [Mental Health Outpatient | Treatment in DC, VA, MD & PA](https://www.kolmac.com/what-we-treat/mental-health): Mental health IOP with CBT, DBT, ACT therapies for depression, anxiety, PTSD.
- [Depression Treatment | Mental Health Programs at Kolmac](https://www.kolmac.com/what-we-treat/depression-treatment-at-kolmac-integrated-behavioral-health): Depression treatment with IOP, therapy, and medication management services.
- [Anxiety Treatment | Outpatient Mental Health Programs at Kolmac](https://www.kolmac.com/what-we-treat/anxiety): Anxiety treatment through evidence-based therapy and medication management programs.
- [Mood Disorder Treatment | Outpatient Health Programs at Kolmac](https://www.kolmac.com/what-we-treat/mood-disorder-treatment-at-kolmac-integrated-behavioral-health): Mood disorder and bipolar treatment through outpatient IOP programs.
- [Trauma Treatment | Outpatient Health Programs at Kolmac](https://www.kolmac.com/what-we-treat/trauma-treatment-at-kolmac-integrated-behavioral-health): Trauma-focused CBT, EMDR, and DBT through intensive outpatient programs.
- [Adolescent Mental Health Care | Treatment in DC, VA, MD & PA](https://www.kolmac.com/what-we-treat/adolescent-mental-health-treatment): Adolescent mental health treatment programs for anxiety, depression, and behavioral issues.
- [Gambling Addiction Treatment – Outpatient Programs](https://www.kolmac.com/what-we-treat/gambling-addiction): Gambling addiction treatment through outpatient IOP and continuing care programs.
